name: pickit-claude-plugins
description: Shareable Claude Code plugins -- reusable setup for common tooling (Fabric SQL connections, Confluence sync, Apps Script development, flowcharting, and a PM/business skills library).

plugins.name: fabric-connect
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to a Microsoft Fabric SQL analytics endpoint (Lakehouse or Warehouse) without admin rights and without an Entra ID app registration -- device-code login, persistent token cache, and a reusable query runner.

plugins.name: flowchart-builder
plugins.description: Convert requirements, notes, transcripts, or rough process descriptions into a polished Mermaid (.mmd) flowchart, with curated themes and auto-validation.

plugins.name: confluence-live-sync
plugins.description: Generic, config-driven, bidirectional sync between a project folder and its linked Confluence page -- matches folder name to a Jira issue's summary, no hardcoded project/template. Optional background watch via a Windows scheduled task running headless Claude Code.

plugins.name: appscript-clasp
plugins.description: Develop Google Apps Script projects locally with Claude using clasp -- create/clone standalone, container-bound (Sheets/Docs/Forms), or web app projects, write and iterate on code, push/pull, run functions, tail logs, and manage deployments.

plugins.name: pm-skills
plugins.description: A library of ~50 product-management and business skills: discovery, PRD writing, roadmap planning, stakeholder mapping, finance/SaaS metrics, diagramming, PDF/PPTX/XLSX generation, prompt engineering, and more.
